format: per take: per tick part rot (xRot,yRot,zRot rad), offset_px from the vanilla pivot, forward/up in blocks, the lock, crater cells (removed tick, rebuilt or dissolved tick). 20 ticks a second.
primed_rule: fast (>= 1 b/tick) and shift (flight) or crouch (super jump fall) held -> locked into the dive at once; touchdown -> instant crater, 0.7 s lock
unprimed_rule: no shift: touch down and slide (5 blocks), the trench spreads with you

P1.name: primed flight slam (shift), 7x7 instant, rebuild ripples from your look
P1.rebuild: ripple from look, 1 tick a block

P2.name: primed super-jump slam (crouch), 9x9 instant, rebuild follows your sweep
P2.rebuild: follows the crosshair sweep, 2 ticks a column

U1.name: unprimed landing, slide 5 blocks, trench spreads with you
